per_root: Rank full partitions by SHA256(seed:partition_key), choose first partition with all six pose streams and at least one joint-valid causal tick. Choose common-valid eligible tick nearest the partition center. Fall back by same ranking and document every missing witness.
scenario_tie_break: SHA256(seed:scenario:partition_key:tick), with scopes and missingness disclosed
extreme_tie_break: descending metric, then partition key, tick, stream and node ascending
known_E1_witnesses: Prefer independent root selections. Report exact physical index pairs reused, if any.
